newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skandia falls, Stadshypotek jump on merger.
newsitem.headline: Skandia falls, Stadshypotek jump on merger.

text.p: Shares in Swedish insurer Skandia tumbled and mortgage bank Stadshypotek jumped when trading resumed on Monday after a merger announcement.

Trading was suspended by the Stockholm bourse before the market opened on Monday and within minutes of resuming at 1345 GMT, Skandia shares were 5.5 crowns lower at 203 crowns. Within five minutes the share price stabilised a little and was 1.5 crowns lower at 207 crowns.
Stadshypotek shares rose 12 to 210 instantly but fell back to be 7.0 crowns up after five minutes.
The two companies early Monday announced a proposed merger to form a giant Nordic financial company with assets of 500 billion crowns.
But Finance Minister Erik Asbrink criticised the plan and said the government would pursue its plan, announced on Saturday, to sell its 34 percent stake of Stadshypotek through a controlled auction.
